name: hatchlock
description: Minimal-diff, type-safety, optimization and architecture skills that keep code changes small, compiler-verified and free of type-checker escape hatches.

interface.longDescription: HatchLock keeps AI-written code changes small and honest. tight-diff enforces minimal, surgical edits that never silence the type checker with @ts-ignore, as any, # type: ignore or similar escape hatches. optimize finds N+1 queries, accidental O(N^2) loops and prompt-caching mistakes. architect designs data-first schemas with a three-option trade-off matrix. clean inlines single-use abstractions and flattens nested control flow without changing behaviour. Skills only: runs no code and connects to no services.
defaultPrompt: Fix the type errors in src/billing.ts without using any or @ts-ignore.
Optimize the /orders endpoint, it runs one query per line item.
Clean up lib/report_builder.py without changing its behaviour.
